description: Briefs for the animated chart with one takeaway (educational.chart-story): categories, a time series, a short list, and one brief that lacks the values.

briefs.brief: Explainer chart: how residents of Lakeside get to work, share of commuters in 2025. Bus 34%, Car 28%, Bicycle 17%, Walking 12%, Train 9%. The point: the bus is now the most common way to work. Source: Lakeside travel survey 2025.

Show how heat pump installations grew, installations per year in thousands: 2021 18, 2022 27, 2023 41, 2024 58, 2025 79. Make it a line chart; the takeaway is that installations more than quadrupled in four years. Source: National Heat Pump Register, 2026 release.

Visitors to the city's three museums in 2025: Maritime Museum 214,000, Art Gallery 162,000, Science Hall 98,000. Highlight the Maritime Museum, which drew the most visitors. Source: City Museums annual report 2025. Ocean look.
Make a chart showing that our coffee shop sells more oat milk lattes than any other drink. Source: till data from March.
briefs.note: Names one category and no values; label and value slots are verbatim, so they must be reported missing.
